definitions.gloss: custom; customization; customized version (of a product, vehicle, software setting, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Modification or configuration of a product to suit individual taste or needs. Used heavily in tech (custom UI/settings), automotive (custom cars and bikes), gaming (custom controllers, builds), and merchandise. Often used with する as a verb meaning "to customize."

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧カスタム⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧{好|ごの}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カスタム⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧。
examples.english: A bicycle customized to my own taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧カスタム⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can customize the notifications in this app.

examples.japanese: ⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧⟦{仕様|しよう}→仕様：00472_shiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ず、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パーツ→パーツ：11272_paatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧カスタム⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{回|まわ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Not satisfied with the maker's standard specs, he drives around in a car he customized himself by swapping out parts.

notes:
カスタム is the English loanword "custom" used in the sense of "customized." In Japanese it freely combines with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb (カスタム⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to customize) and shows up in many compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カスタム⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to customize
- カスタム⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: customization (the process)
- カスタム⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧: custom settings
- カスタムメイド: custom-made (commonly used for tailored clothing, custom-built PCs, etc.)
- カスタム⟦パーツ→パーツ：11272_paatsu⟧: custom parts (esp. for cars, bikes, PCs)
- カスタムカー: customized car
- フルカスタム: fully customized (a build with extensive modifications)

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦カスタマイズ→カスタマイズ：10870_kasutamaizu⟧: customization — the longer-form loanword, common in software contexts (e.g., UI customization, browser settings); largely interchangeable with カスタム but a touch more formal in IT writing.
- ⟦{改造|かいぞう}→改造：00145_kaizou⟧: modification, conversion — a stronger native term often used for substantial mechanical or structural alteration (cars, motorcycles, game consoles), and sometimes carrying a borderline-illegal connotation depending on the domain.
- ⟦{特注|とくちゅう}→特注：13486_tokuchuu⟧: custom order; specially ordered — used for one-off or made-to-order items (e.g., ⟦{特注|とくちゅう}→特注：13486_tokuchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧ "custom-ordered furniture").
- オーダー⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧: made-to-order — closely related to カスタムメイド but emphasizes the ordering process rather than the modifications.

USAGE:
- カスタム is informal in feel; product marketing copy and IT documentation often prefer ⟦カスタマイズ→カスタマイズ：10870_kasutamaizu⟧ in formal sentences ("⟦カスタマイズ→カスタマイズ：10870_kasutamaizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です" rather than "カスタム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です").
- For deeper modifications that change the original specs (engine swaps, hardware replacements), ⟦{改造|かいぞう}→改造：00145_kaizou⟧ or カスタム are both used, with ⟦{改造|かいぞう}→改造：00145_kaizou⟧ sounding more technical or, in some contexts, more illicit.
